title: Generative UI V1 (1 of 4): evidence model, scene schema and validator
requested_outcome: Owner-approved Generative UI V1, objective 1 of 4: the server-side evidence model, scene schema and scene validator, in a new package crooks-assistant/app/scenes that nothing uses yet, so what the live app renders does not change. The rule: connectors describe data, CLIVE decides what to show, the screen shows findings not sources. Today app/presentation.py maps tool results to about thirty-five fixed provider-shaped card types, so whatever an investigation touches is drawn and every new connector needs new card types. On 2026-09-24 the owner asked 'any customers who need a reply' and got one correct sentence plus five cards and more than forty rows, including a ranked list of twenty-five customers with their email addresses. Build: (1) app/scenes/evidence.py - typed evidence. Field kinds: money (amount plus ISO currency), count, ratio, datetime, duration, status, person, link, text, series. A FieldDescriptor has name, kind, label, pii flag and unit or currency where relevant. Evidence has a handle, the source tool name, observed_at, a short query summary and records whose fields are described. A connector registers descriptors for its output; there is no UI code per connector. (2) app/scenes/descriptors.py - descriptors for the read tools in app/tools/shopify_tools.py, app/tools/gmail_tools.py and app/tools/analytics_tools.py, and an adapter from each such tool's result to Evidence. Customer email, phone and address fields are pii. (3) app/scenes/scene.py - a strict scene-plan schema (pydantic, extra fields forbidden) over a closed set of primitives: Answer (one or two lines), Finding (significance one of ACTION_REQUIRED, DECISION_REQUIRED, RISK, UNCERTAINTY, LIMITATION, CONTEXT, with text and evidence references), Entity (an evidence record and chosen fields), Collection (an evidence handle, chosen columns, a row limit), Measure (an evidence field and period), Comparison, Trend (a series reference), Timeline, Proposal (a reference to an existing action only) and Question. Every value-bearing element points at evidence handles and field names; a plan cannot carry free-standing numbers or markup. Every element carries a one-line justification. (4) app/scenes/validate.py - pure functions, no I/O: validate_scene(plan, evidence, context) returns the accepted scene and a decision trace. It refuses any value not bound to evidence from this session; drops elements with no justification; enforces an attention budget (default one Answer plus at most three further elements, and a Collection at most eight rows unless the request explicitly asks to see a list); strips pii fields unless the context says the task needs contact details; always keeps the Answer; and records every element kept or dropped with the reason. When only the Answer survives, the scene is the Answer plus a drill-down reference to the evidence it checked. (5) tests/test_scenes.py covering at least: a synthetic reproduction of the 2026-09-24 case (about forty rows across orders, threads and customers where the finding is that nobody is waiting) validates to one Answer plus drill-down with no pii; a nothing-needs-you case is one line; an adversarial plan with invented numbers, markup, unjustified elements, an over-budget collection and pii columns is reduced correctly with every reduction in the trace; and a synthetic ads connector registered only through descriptors (spend as money, ROAS as a ratio, daily spend as a series) yields a valid Answer, Finding and Trend scene with no connector-specific code anywhere in app/scenes. Do not modify app/presentation.py, app/render.py, routes or anything the live app renders; wiring the planner and renderer comes in later objectives. This objective continues from its own earlier candidate, the base commit a196809537 (branch clive/objective/generative-ui-v1-evidence-scenes-2). Four rounds of independent review brought the open findings down from four to two (F-01, F-02) before the repair budget ran out; the review of your change will state what remains. Check the base against every acceptance criterion, close anything that falls short, and keep changes inside the allowed paths. You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output, and the independent review returns its findings, to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: app/scenes holds the evidence model, descriptors for the existing Shopify, Gmail and analytics read tools, the scene-plan schema and a pure validator with a decision trace
the 2026-09-24 case validates to one Answer plus drill-down with no pii, and a nothing-needs-you case to one line
an adversarial plan loses every invented value, unjustified element, over-budget row and pii column, each recorded in the trace
a synthetic connector registered only through descriptors yields a valid scene with no connector-specific code in app/scenes
nothing the live app renders changes: app/presentation.py, app/render.py and routes are untouched
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
